Team + Lena —

Attaching a draft mutual action plan (MAP) and a lightweight executive briefing (EB) meeting grid for Northstar. Goal: land contract signature and production kick-off by 2026-12-07. High-level asks in this thread:

- Internal: confirm exec sponsor assignments and name back-up(s) for escalation coverage.
- External: confirm which exec(s) will attend the EB and their general availability windows.
- Ops: agree on first EB agenda and what procurement needs in parallel.

Key items in the attached MAP_Northstar_draft_v1.xlsx:
1) Executive sponsor matrix (primary + succession layer)
2) Week-by-week milestones toward signature (legal/procurement/tech eval)
3) Evaluation criteria for latency/cost targets and data-isolation needs

Initial proposal (please review and flag conflicts):
- Primary sponsor: Dr. Lena Ortiz (Northstar, EVP Product & Strategy)
- Secondary sponsor (internal Redwood): Marissa Cole (VP, Sales) — visible to executives
- Backup (on-call escalation): Rishi Malhotra (Head of Platform Partnerships)
- EB meeting cadence: three meetings over four weeks leading to signature; weekly 45-min slots; first EB proposed: Wed 2026-11-24 10:00 PT (provisional)

Attachments: MAP_Northstar_draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), EB_meeting_grid_v1.pdf (grid)

Please reply with: 1) acceptance or alternate backup names, 2) any blockers for the proposed cadence, 3) whether we can lock the first EB on 11/24 if Lena confirms.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
